summary_dat <- dat %>%

  summarise(
    mean_rating = mean(probability_rating, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(probability_rating, na.rm = TRUE) /

  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    x = "Temporal delay (ms)",

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Define the actual temporal delays in their correct order
delay_values <- c(
  -500, -250, -100, -50, -33, -17, 0,
   17,  33,  50, 100, 250, 500
)

# Create an artificial equally-spaced x coordinate
summary_dat_zoom <- summary_dat %>%
  filter(delay_ms %in% delay_values) %>%
  mutate(
    plot_x = match(delay_ms, delay_values)
  )

# Plot
p_zoom_even <- ggplot(
  summary_dat_zoom,
  aes(
    x = plot_x,
    y = mean_rating,
    color = condition,
    group = condition
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = mean_rating - se,
      ymax = mean_rating + se
    ),
    width = 0.12
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq_along(delay_values),
    labels = delay_values
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.08))
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1,
      size = 14
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 17),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 15),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Temporal delay (ms)",
    y = "Mean causal judgment",
    color = "Condition"
  )

) +

    aes(
      ymin = mean_rating - se,
      ymax = mean_rating + se
    ),
    width = 15
  ) +

    breaks = c(-1000, -500, -250, 0, 250, 500, 1000)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.08))
  ) +

    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1

  ) +
  labs(

p_zoom <- ggplot(
  summary_dat %>%
    filter(delay_ms >= -500 & delay_ms <= 500),
  aes(
    x = delay_ms,
    y = mean_rating,
    color = condition,
    group = condition
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +

    aes(
      ymin = mean_rating - se,
      ymax = mean_rating + se

  ) +

    limits = c(-250, 250),

      -250, -100, -50, -33, -17,
      0,
      17, 33, 50, 100, 250
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(

    x = "Temporal delay (ms)",

  )

str(model_dat)

model_dat$participant <- factor(model_dat$participant)
model_dat$condition <- factor(model_dat$condition)

model_dat$probability_rating <- as.numeric(model_dat$probability_rating)
levels(model_dat$condition)

# ============================================================
# WITHIN-PARTICIPANT CONDITION DIFFERENCES
# ============================================================

participant_condition <- model_dat %>%
  group_by(participant, condition) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_rating = mean(probability_rating, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = condition,
    values_from = mean_rating
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    difference = intact - scrambled
  )

library(mgcv)

gamm_test <- gam(
  probability_rating ~
    condition +
    s(delay_ms, k = 8) +
    s(participant, bs = "re"),
  data = model_dat,
  method = "REML" 
)

summary(gamm_test)
## 
## Family: gaussian 
## Link function: identity 
## 
## Formula:
## probability_rating ~ condition + s(delay_ms, k = 8) + s(participant, 
##     bs = "re")
## 
## Parametric coefficients:
##                    Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
## (Intercept)          69.985      6.149   11.38   <2e-16 ***
## conditionscrambled  -16.250      9.393   -1.73    0.085 .  
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Approximate significance of smooth terms:
##                   edf Ref.df      F p-value    
## s(delay_ms)     5.302   6.16 14.713  <2e-16 ***
## s(participant) 10.887  12.00  9.781  <2e-16 ***
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## R-sq.(adj) =  0.502   Deviance explained = 53.8%
## -REML = 1086.2  Scale est. = 476.95    n = 238
gamm <- gam(
  probability_rating ~
    condition +
    s(delay_ms, by = condition, k = 8) + #Give each condition its own nonlinear temporal curve.
    s(participant, bs = "re"),
  data = model_dat,
  method = "REML"
)

summary(gamm)
## 
## Family: gaussian 
## Link function: identity 
## 
## Formula:
## probability_rating ~ condition + s(delay_ms, by = condition, 
##     k = 8) + s(participant, bs = "re")
## 
## Parametric coefficients:
##                    Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
## (Intercept)          69.985      6.149   11.38   <2e-16 ***
## conditionscrambled  -16.250      9.393   -1.73    0.085 .  
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Approximate significance of smooth terms:
##                                   edf Ref.df     F  p-value    
## s(delay_ms):conditionintact     4.122  4.995 8.373 6.31e-07 ***
## s(delay_ms):conditionscrambled  4.679  5.576 7.737 7.66e-07 ***
## s(participant)                 10.862 12.000 9.546  < 2e-16 ***
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## R-sq.(adj) =  0.491   Deviance explained = 53.5%
## -REML = 1088.7  Scale est. = 487.58    n = 238
gam.check(gamm_test)

## 
## Method: REML   Optimizer: outer newton
## full convergence after 6 iterations.
## Gradient range [-1.944452e-05,1.359258e-05]
## (score 1086.223 & scale 476.947).
## Hessian positive definite, eigenvalue range [1.405533,117.8023].
## Model rank =  23 / 23 
## 
## Basis dimension (k) checking results. Low p-value (k-index<1) may
## indicate that k is too low, especially if edf is close to k'.
## 
##                  k'  edf k-index p-value
## s(delay_ms)     7.0  5.3    1.11    0.94
## s(participant) 14.0 10.9      NA      NA
plot(gamm, pages = 1)

gam.check(gamm)

## 
## Method: REML   Optimizer: outer newton
## full convergence after 6 iterations.
## Gradient range [-2.59655e-05,1.786431e-05]
## (score 1088.653 & scale 487.5803).
## Hessian positive definite, eigenvalue range [0.8517349,117.3125].
## Model rank =  30 / 30 
## 
## Basis dimension (k) checking results. Low p-value (k-index<1) may
## indicate that k is too low, especially if edf is close to k'.
## 
##                                   k'   edf k-index p-value
## s(delay_ms):conditionintact     7.00  4.12    1.08    0.91
## s(delay_ms):conditionscrambled  7.00  4.68    1.08    0.93
## s(participant)                 14.00 10.86      NA      NA
model_diff <- gam(
  probability_rating ~
    condition +
    s(delay_ms, by = condition, k = 8) +
    s(participant, bs = "re"),
  data = model_dat,
  method = "ML" 
)
model_same <- gam(
  probability_rating ~
    condition +
    s(delay_ms, k = 8) +
    s(participant, bs = "re"),
  data = model_dat,
  method = "ML"
)
#Graph 2, ANOVA Results Table

anova(model_same, model_diff, test = "Chisq") #whether the two-curve model fits significantly better than the shared-curve model. Answer: Yes, the two temporal curves differ in pilot data.
## Analysis of Deviance Table
## 
## Model 1: probability_rating ~ condition + s(delay_ms, k = 8) + s(participant, 
##     bs = "re")
## Model 2: probability_rating ~ condition + s(delay_ms, by = condition, 
##     k = 8) + s(participant, bs = "re")
##   Resid. Df Resid. Dev     Df Deviance Pr(>Chi)
## 1    217.20     105167                         
## 2    211.77     106385 5.4351  -1217.7
# Create prediction data
newdat <- expand.grid(
  delay_ms = seq(
    min(model_dat$delay_ms),
    max(model_dat$delay_ms),
    length.out = 300
  ),
  condition = levels(model_dat$condition),
  participant = NA
)

# Make sure participant has the same factor structure as in the model
newdat$participant <- factor(
  newdat$participant,
  levels = levels(model_dat$participant)
)

# Predict causal judgment
pred <- predict(
  model_diff,
  newdata = newdat,
  se.fit = TRUE
)

# Add predicted values
newdat$fit <- pred$fit
newdat$se <- pred$se.fit

# 95% confidence interval
newdat$lower <- newdat$fit - 1.96 * newdat$se
newdat$upper <- newdat$fit + 1.96 * newdat$se
head(newdat)
##     delay_ms condition participant fit se lower upper

## 4  -979.9331    intact        <NA>  NA NA    NA    NA
## 5  -973.2441    intact        <NA>  NA NA    NA    NA
## 6  -966.5552    intact        <NA>  NA NA    NA    NA
#predicted results visualization
#1.Create prediction data using an actual participant
levels(model_dat$participant)
##  [1] "s003" "s006" "s007" "s008" "s009" "s010" "s011" "s012" "s013" "s014"
## [11] "s015" "s018" "s020" "s021"
newdat <- expand.grid(
  delay_ms = seq(
    min(model_dat$delay_ms),
    max(model_dat$delay_ms),
    length.out = 300
  ),
  condition = levels(model_dat$condition),
  participant = levels(model_dat$participant)[1]
)

pred <- predict(
  gamm,
  newdata = newdat,
  se.fit = TRUE,
  exclude = "s(participant)"
)
#2.Add the confidence intervals
newdat$fit <- as.numeric(pred$fit)
newdat$se <- as.numeric(pred$se.fit)

newdat$lower <- newdat$fit - 1.96 * newdat$se
newdat$upper <- newdat$fit + 1.96 * newdat$se

summary(newdat$fit)
